Definition: a letter or other mark branded on the skin
BiblicalUsage: Kethobeth means a mark branded on the skin, a tattoo. Leviticus 19:28 says ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God marks his people by his Spirit, not by cuts in the flesh, and this law kept Israel from copying the mourning rites of the dead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
